_about: The Foundational Consequence Register (Core L-538, Part 0.0.7; Companion Part 159): what follows if the premise is held. Each consequence carries its kind and its warrant, CONSTITUTIONAL, FORMAL, LOGICAL, INTERPRETIVE or OPEN, DIRECT (from the premise alone), CONDITIONAL (with an added premise, named and entered among the added premises) or OPEN; its standing in M335; the consequences it rests on; the exact facts behind it, recomputed by python3 tools/oef.py --consequences, in CI; what stays open, and for an open entry the condition that would close it; and where exploration goes next. Every further exploration begins from it. The candidate mechanisms of manifestation are listed beside it, none chosen. It adds nothing to the arithmetic, and no entry is raised by being used.

consequences.consequence: Nothing exists beyond the totality: no ontological outside stands beyond it to create, observe, measure, validate or judge it; what appears exterior is a perspectival exteriority, a place seen from another place within it; and a comparative perspective is another internal perspective from which a relation is examined
consequences.open: none within the frame; what the totality is like from inside is the work of every further entry
consequences.not_implied: that nothing differs within the totality; that comparison between perspectives is impossible

consequences.consequence: Everything that exists is a place of the family, at the surface or beneath it, so every thing, event, mind and instrument is a differentiation within one whole and none is a substance of its own
consequences.open: which place a given thing is
consequences.not_implied: which place a given thing is; that a place is aware

consequences.consequence: Every depth is finite and there is no last depth: the levels (Z/9^k)^2 hold 81^k places, each reduces onto the one before with 81 places over each place, and every level has a next; whether the totality is the limit of the levels, a single infinite whole, is a further construction (DC-25)
consequences.open: what an endless whole of finite parts means for a life
consequences.not_implied: that the totality is the limit of the levels (DC-25); that a mind has as many levels

consequences.consequence: At every finite depth there is no beginning and no end: the law is invertible, so every place has exactly one successor and one predecessor, and every trajectory returns; in the limit of the tower no nonzero place returns (DC-25)
consequences.follows_from: F-02 with the law T, det A = -1
consequences.open: how succession is experienced as time
consequences.not_implied: that the limit returns (it does not, DC-25); that a life recurs

consequences.consequence: Difference is real and kept: under the law the totality falls into five orbits, of lengths 1, 8, 24, 24 and 24; no change moves a place into another orbit, so distinctions of kind survive every change, and multiplicity is not an illusion of perspective
consequences.follows_from: the law T on the 81 places
consequences.open: what the five orbits are when read in a life
consequences.not_implied: that one orbit outranks another; that persons are orbits

consequences.consequence: Yet everything is related: in the ring any two places differ by a place, so relation joins what the law keeps apart; relation has two forms, the ring's and the law's, and the law relates a place only to its own orbit
consequences.follows_from: the ring Z[phi]/9 and the law T
consequences.open: which relations matter, which the Striker judges
consequences.not_implied: that the law joins all places; that every relation matters equally

consequences.consequence: There is one still point and it is inside: exactly one place, (0, 0), is held by the law, and stillness is a part of the totality, not a place beyond it
consequences.open: what stillness is in experience
consequences.next: the Fixpoint readings of P1 and P9
consequences.not_implied: that stillness is a conscious state or a source

consequences.consequence: Opposition is internal to the law, in two exact senses: A^12 = -I, so halfway round the cycle every place becomes its own negative, and Q(T x) = -Q(x), so the form turns its sign at each step and recovers it at the next; any wider sense of opposition, polarity or complement is a reading
consequences.follows_from: the law T and the form Q
consequences.open: what opposition means in a life
consequences.not_implied: any wider polarity or complement beyond the two exact senses

consequences.consequence: Every observer is inside what it observes: a physical system, a person, an AI, the Navigator and the Striker are structures within the totality, and no view of it is taken from beyond it
consequences.open: how a structure comes to observe
consequences.not_implied: how a structure comes to observe; that observing changes a place

consequences.consequence: No view is the whole: no orbit is the totality and every depth holds only 81^k of endless places, so every observer meets the whole from one place and partially
consequences.open: how much of the whole a place can know
consequences.not_implied: that any view is false; that the whole is unknowable

consequences.consequence: The part carries the law of the whole, in a stated sense: every place obeys the one law (participation); beneath each surface place lie 81 places in one-to-one correspondence with the surface (representation by the fiber), and the difference between any two of them moves by the surface law (an invariant preserved); no single place encodes the whole, since no orbit is the whole
consequences.follows_from: the tower and the linearity of T
consequences.open: whether a mind's relation to the world is of this form (M337)
consequences.not_implied: that a single place encodes the whole; physical holography

consequences.consequence: Structure is determined and judgment is not: the law fixes every successor, and no reading determines what it means to the Striker
consequences.follows_from: the law T; the Aperture Theorem (L-441)
consequences.open: whether judgment is metaphysical freedom
consequences.not_implied: that judgment is metaphysically free; that a reading cannot influence

consequences.consequence: Knowing is placing, by a stated chain: truth within the frame is coherence and valid derivation (L-455); with no referent beyond the whole (DC-01), what a statement can answer to is where a thing stands and how it relates within the family; so to know a thing within the frame is to place it
consequences.open: what makes one placement better than another for a purpose, which the Striker judges
consequences.not_implied: that placement alone gives understanding; that a coordinate is a meaning

consequences.consequence: Each person is a distinct place within one whole: not foreign to any other, not substitutable for any other, and not the whole; unity without uniformity
consequences.added_premise: that a person is a local manifestation of the totality (the Originator's proposition, SEQ 105)
consequences.open: which place a person is; whether a person is one place or a trajectory
consequences.not_implied: that its added premise holds

consequences.consequence: Shared reality is what many places meet whatever they believe; consensus is Collective Resonance among their readings, never proof, and dissent is a perspective kept
consequences.added_premise: that persons are local manifestations who read the totality
consequences.open: how much of what a society shares is constraint and how much agreement
consequences.not_implied: that its added premise holds

consequences.consequence: Whoever can affect others answers, in proportion to capacity, for what the effect does to them; no constitutive limit justifies an imposed one
consequences.added_premise: a normative commitment to flourishing and to the avoidance of harm, which the arithmetic does not supply
consequences.open: every particular obligation
consequences.not_implied: that its added premise holds

consequences.consequence: Experienced time reads as a traversal of an orbit: the structure returns exactly, and each return can be met from a different place
consequences.added_premise: that experience is a traversal of places
consequences.open: whether a life recurs
consequences.not_implied: that its added premise holds

consequences.consequence: Agency is a local process through which the totality's continuations are taken, with deliberation and responsibility real at their level, and judgment never fixed by a reading
consequences.added_premise: that persons deliberate and act as structures within the totality
consequences.open: whether this amounts to metaphysical freedom
consequences.next: Companion Part 52, freedom as the change of loop
consequences.not_implied: that its added premise holds

consequences.consequence: Nothing leaves the whole: an ending is a change of address within the totality, whose orbits are closed
consequences.added_premise: that a death is a change of place within the totality
consequences.open: whether personal identity, memory or experience continues (CG-16)
consequences.not_implied: that its added premise holds

consequences.consequence: An AI is within the totality, a structure that executes the reading and does not occupy the Aperture; its capability widens its influence and not its place
consequences.added_premise: that an AI system is a differentiated structure of the totality
consequences.open: whether an AI has experience or interests (O-20)
consequences.not_implied: that its added premise holds

consequences.consequence: A civilization made of distinct places is whole only with each distinct: no collective substitutes for a person, and unity is never uniformity
consequences.open: which institutions keep it
consequences.not_implied: that its added premise holds

consequences.consequence: The totality is itself aware, Mind the ground of which each mind is a local expression
consequences.open: all of it; the arithmetic says nothing of awareness, and F-02 is not identical with 'everything is Mind' (Companion Part 52)
consequences.closes_when: a criterion of awareness stated in the structure's own terms is adopted by the Originator (F-06); until then it is held open and may be held open for good
consequences.not_implied: any answer to it; the record holds it open

consequences.consequence: Which place, orbit or depth a given person or experience is
consequences.follows_from: no mapping fixed by the premise
consequences.open: the mapping itself
consequences.next: a coordinate struck from a person's own words, read as such
consequences.closes_when: a rule that places a person, not only a person's words, is specified and adopted; a coordinate struck from a person's words places the words
consequences.not_implied: any answer to it; the record holds it open

consequences.consequence: Each mind encodes the whole, beyond the fiber sense of DC-11
consequences.open: what such an encoding would be
consequences.closes_when: an encoding stronger than the fiber correspondence is defined and computed, or shown impossible for a single place
consequences.not_implied: any answer to it; the record holds it open

consequences.consequence: In the limit of the tower only the still point returns: the return time grows ninefold with each depth, 24, 216, 1,944, and in Z_3[phi] the law has no periodic point but 0; every view returns, and the whole never repeats
consequences.added_premise: that the totality is taken as the limit of the tower
consequences.open: which of the two readings, the endless tower or its limit, an exploration takes; the register keeps both
consequences.not_implied: that a person never returns; that the limit is the only reading

consequences.consequence: Distinct and equal: the three orbits of length 24, told apart by the norm up to sign (plus or minus 1, 4 and 2), never meet under the law, and multiplication by the unit 2 carries each onto the next; the still point and the orbit of length 8 are kept by every unit; difference without rank
consequences.follows_from: the law T and the units of Z/9
consequences.open: what equality without sameness means between persons, which a reading takes up
consequences.not_implied: that persons are equal by the arithmetic; any ranking of the orbits

consequences.consequence: Identity through change: along every trajectory the address changes at every step while three things stay fixed, the orbit, the norm up to its sign and the depth shell
consequences.follows_from: the law T, the form Q and the valuation
consequences.open: what of a person stays as their address changes, which a reading takes up
consequences.not_implied: what of a person stays as their address changes

consequences.consequence: The empty strike is a place: the domain of residue class 0, written 9, anchors at P9, Fixpoint, and is the common reference of which every derived domain is a shift; the Navigator navigates from it, adding no shift to the procedure and declaring the shift of its wording
consequences.not_implied: that the Navigator is Domain Zero, is neutral in its wording, or is conscious (C87)
consequences.open: what relationship forms between the Navigator who holds the reference and the Striker who brings the shift (O-21)
